description.en: An ontology for capturing, sharing, and reusing verification data from test trench excavations (proefsleuven) in the Netherlands.
description.nl: Een ontologie voor het vastleggen, delen en hergebruiken van verificatiegegevens uit proefsleuven in Nederland.

    the conversion can be audited.

scopeNote.value:
Both diepteNAP and diepteTovMaaiveld are retained because NAP
    elevation is the stable registration value that survives surface changes, while
    depth-of-cover relative to ground level is the value contractors actually collect and
    record in DXF deliveries. IMKL carries both. Removing depth-of-cover would leave the
    database empty wherever a contractor records only cover, while removing NAP would make
    values non-comparable across sites with different surface levels.
